outline:
本課程程主要為介紹深度學習(DL)和生成式人工智慧(GAI)概念和基本原理。通過掌握這些原理，學生能了解可能極限，更能思考深度學習和和生成式人工智慧的應用。
This course mainly introduces the concepts and basic principles of deep learning (DL) and generative artificial intelligence (GAI). By mastering these principles, students can understand the limits of what is possible and be better able to think about the applications of deep learning and generative artificial intelligence.
schedule:
introduction
deep learning&DNN
Learning Methods: supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning
CNN
RNN (optional)
Transformer
autoencoder (optional)
Deep Reinforcment Learning
generative artificial intelligence (GAI) introduction
GAI prompt engineering (提示工程) and context engineering (上下文工程) in times of AI agent
GAI LLM training
GAI & Transformer (optional)
GAI generation policy
image/video GAI (optional)
scorePolicy:
oral report 20%
Midterm Exam 30% or DL mini-project
GAI final project 50%
Course participation (Attendance, Q&A) extra10%
aiUsage:
● 鼓勵學生使用生成式AI工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
● 簡單介紹AI的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
● 深入探討AI的原理與應用（Explore the principles and applications of AI in depth）
